paragraphs.text: The Accorders were a white -aligned military/religious group among the Auriok residing on Mirrodin .

The Accorders enforced the Accord of Equity, a statement of rights for the Auriok people. Wandering between the various Auriok settlements, the Accorders dispensed justice and protected their settlements from outside threats.

Most Accorders died in the battles against New Phyrexia , with the few surviving becoming part of the Mirran Resistance . One post they secured was Bladehold, one of the few pockets of Mirran resistance against the contagion.
